context: Confirm whether platform_info already flows into the exported payload - if it does this may be grouping-only. Note pg_user/pg_password are deliberately omitted from get_platform_info and must stay omitted; only the backend KIND and storage location are wanted, never connection credentials.
description: ADR decision w12 (docs/development/adr/adr-ducklake-maturity-and-publishability.md) makes remote-backed DuckLake results publishable and ranking-eligible ON CONDITION that each run records its catalog backend and storage location, so comparisons do not silently mix backings - a DuckLake-on-S3 number partly measures object-store latency and must not be ranked against DuckLake-on-local-disk as the same system. The ADR states this wiring is follow-up work and does not cover it. get_platform_info() already exposes catalog_backend, data_path and data_path_is_cloud, and the registry models the two axes as four deployment modes since the w10 fix, so the vocabulary exists; what is missing is that these reach exported result metadata and are used for comparison grouping.

preserves.behavior: Existing exported result fields keep their current names and meanings
pg_user/pg_password stay absent from platform info and exported results

verifications.description: An exported DuckLake result records catalog backend and storage location
verifications.expected: all pass; new case asserts both fields present and no credentials

work_units.evidence: benchbox/platforms/ducklake.py get_normalized_result_metadata() override: populates platform_storage with catalog_backend + data_path_is_cloud + storage_location (the generic builder leaves it empty for ducklake), and scrubs _CREDENTIAL_CONFIG_KEYS from platform_raw_config. FOUND A LIVE LEAK: pg_user reached exported metadata via adapter.platform_config - get_platform_info omits it but the normalized builder also reads the raw constructor config, where pg_password matches the shared secret matcher and pg_user does not. Verified: both axes recorded, zero credential leaks for postgres+s3 and duckdb+local
work_units.summary: Ensure catalog backend + storage location reach exported result metadata
